prompt: Create a professional PowerPoint presentation (saved as 'anthropic_brand_demo.pptx') showcasing Anthropic's brand guidelines. The presentation should contain exactly 4 slides: (1) Title slide with 'Anthropic Brand Guidelines' as the title and 'Visual Identity Showcase' as subtitle, (2) Colors slide showing all brand colors with their hex values, (3) Typography slide demonstrating both heading and body text styles, and (4) Summary slide with key takeaways. Apply Anthropic's official brand colors and typography throughout using the brand-guidelines skill. Use proper heading hierarchy with slide titles at 28pt and body text at 14pt. Include at least one colored shape on each content slide using the accent colors.
